market_derivatives.disagreement: Liquidation totals range from ~$11.4M verified four-venue events to ~$46M nine-venue aggregate/estimated feeds. cftc_futures_only_report.report_type: Traders in Financial Futures, futures only

products.product: NANO XRP PERP STYLE - Coinbase Derivatives LLC

cftc_futures_only_report.interpretation: The CFTC report is a regulated-market subset, not global XRP positioning. Leveraged funds are net short in Coinbase's perpetual-style contract but net long in CME standard XRP futures; other reportables are net long in both Coinbase nano products. This can reflect cross-product basis/hedging as well as directional views. The 50% fall in monthly Nano XRP OI may reflect expiry/roll or de-risking; no direct roll mapping is proven. Do not combine these positions into one directional signal.
cftc_futures_only_report.next_report: The latest official report visible in this run is as of Nov 3; the Nov 10 report was not yet available on Nov 15.

counter_hypotheses: Offshore long-liquidation cascade: several providers show negative funding and long-heavy liquidations.
Provider coverage/estimation explains much of the liquidation-total gap; verified exchange events and modeled or inferred totals are not interchangeable.
Regulated CME leveraged funds are net long while Coinbase perp-style leveraged funds are net short; cross-product basis hedging is plausible.
The large monthly Nano XRP OI reduction may be expiry/roll, not broad XRP deleveraging.
Options show negative put skew while far-dated Dec25 open interest is call-heavy; hedging and upside speculation coexist.
A positive price rebound after a sharp daily decline is not proof of trend reversal.
model_admission: Research-only. CFTC data is weekly and as of Nov3; options are secondary and delayed; liquidation aggregators differ in venue coverage and modeled versus verified events. No directional forecast.
